name: Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana
benefit: To the registered beneficiaries, medical assistance of ₹ 20,000/- or the actual expenditure incurred on the treatment, whichever is less, will be provided.
eligibility_rules: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh state. It is mandatory for construction workers to be registered in any district. Must have completed 90 days as a laborer in the board.
documents_required: certificate. Bank account details. Hospital certificate.
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline Registered construction workers can apply through any CSC center or labor office. Get the application form. Fill out with required details. Attach the necessary documents.
